name: @design-parity/figma-plugin
description: In-Figma client for the design-parity code → design flow: import a compose-preview design-artifact catalog (sticker sheets + DTCG tokens) onto a Figma canvas as authoritative renders plus a variable collection. Ships to the Figma Community, not npm — the pure import planner is the testable core; the figma/ glue is bundled with esbuild.
